label: first input token is e (t=0)
explanation: Fires exactly at step 0 when the first original token is the letter e, and nowhere else. Magnitude is constant (0.769 on every activation), so nothing modulates it: L, later tokens and the digit count have no effect. It does not fire on e at later original positions, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (including when e is output or fed back as input), and it never fires on any other token at t=0. In effect it is a lookup on the token-e input at the zero initial hidden state.
